001package com.streamconverter;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004
005/**
006 * Base exception for stream processing failures, part of the exception policy notification class
007 * hierarchy.
008 *
009 * <p>All failures in StreamConverter pipeline execution are classified into one of three
010 * notification classes:
011 *
012 * <ul>
013 *   <li>{@link UserInputException} (U) — user can fix by correcting input
014 *   <li>{@link ExternalTransientException} (T) — external system temporarily unavailable; user
015 *       should retry
016 *   <li>{@link ExternalPermanentException} or {@link InternalSystemException} (A) — requires
017 *       administrator intervention
018 * </ul>
019 *
020 * <p><strong>Base exception contract:</strong> {@code StreamProcessingException} is the parent of
021 * all notification-class failures, and all concrete notification classes extend this type (either
022 * directly or through {@link ExternalSystemException}).
023 *
024 * <p><strong>Extends IOException:</strong> Callers of {@link
025 * com.streamconverter.command.IStreamCommand#execute} can handle all stream-level failures with a
026 * single {@code catch (IOException)} block, consistent with the method's checked-exception
027 * contract.
028 *
029 * <p><strong>Message mechanism:</strong> All exceptions provide a user-friendly message via {@link
030 * #getUserMessage()}. Concrete types override this to return type-specific messages: {@link
031 * UserInputException} returns a dynamic message provided at construction; other types return a
032 * type-specific {@code DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE} constant suitable for display to end users.
033 *
034 * <p>See docs/reference/EXCEPTION_POLICY.md for the full exception classification policy.
035 *
036 * @see UserInputException
037 * @see ExternalSystemException
038 * @see ExternalTransientException
039 * @see ExternalPermanentException
040 * @see InternalSystemException
041 * @see AggregatedStreamProcessingException
042 */
043public class StreamProcessingException extends IOException {
044  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
045
046  /**
047   * Default user-facing message for generic stream processing failures. Advises users to contact an
048   * administrator.
049   *
050   * <p>Concrete notification-class exceptions (U/T/A) override {@link #getUserMessage()} to return
051   * a type-specific message. This default is used as a fallback for unclassified failures.
052   */
053  public static final String DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE = "システムエラーが発生しました。管理者にお問い合わせください。";
054
055  /**
056   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message.
057   *
058   * @param message the detail message
059   */
060  public StreamProcessingException(String message) {
061    super(message);
062  }
063
064  /**
065   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message and cause.
066   *
067   * @param message the detail message
068   * @param cause the cause of the exception
069   */
070  public StreamProcessingException(String message, Throwable cause) {
071    super(message, cause);
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified cause.
076   *
077   * @param cause the cause of the exception
078   */
079  public StreamProcessingException(Throwable cause) {
080    super(cause);
081  }
082
083  /**
084   * Returns a user-friendly message suitable for display to end users.
085   *
086   * <p>This method is designed to be called by main-layer code to provide consistent end-user
087   * notifications without needing instanceof checks or conditional branching. The message is chosen
088   * based on the notification class:
089   *
090   * <ul>
091   *   <li>{@link UserInputException}: Dynamic message provided at construction time
092   *   <li>{@link ExternalTransientException}: Generic "please retry" message
093   *   <li>{@link ExternalPermanentException}: Generic "contact administrator" message
094   *   <li>{@link InternalSystemException}: Generic "contact administrator" message
095   *   <li>Other subtypes: Returns the base {@link #DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE}
096   * </ul>
097   *
098   * <p>Concrete subtypes override this method to return type-specific messages.
099   *
100   * @return sanitized user-facing message (never contains internal details like stack traces, file
101   *     paths, or class names)
102   */
103  public String getUserMessage() {
104    return DEFAULT_USER_MESSAGE;
105  }
106}
